message:
Command `cd /workspace && cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json <<'JSON'
[
  {"step":1,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__process_frame_header","line":3157,"var":"c","code":"if (c != 3 && c != 1 && c != 4) return stbi__err(\"bad component count\",\"Corrupt JPEG\");","note":"The attacker supplies a supported 4-component JPEG, so the decoder accepts the CMYK frame."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__process_frame_header","line":3173,"var":"z->img_comp[i].h","code":"z->img_comp[i].h = (q >> 4);  if (!z->img_comp[i].h || z->img_comp[i].h > 4) return stbi__err(\"bad H\",\"Corrupt JPEG\");","note":"The SOF sampling factors are attacker-controlled and can be set to an unusual but still accepted arrangement."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__process_frame_header","line":3207,"var":"z->img_comp[i].w2","code":"z->img_comp[i].w2 = z->img_mcu_x * z->img_comp[i].h * 8;","note":"The crafted sampling layout is converted to working component widths, which downstream routines rely on for row processing."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"load_jpeg_image","line":3762,"var":"r->w_lores","code":"r->w_lores = (z->s->img_x + r->hs-1) / r->hs;","note":"The decoder computes a low-resolution row width from the derived scaling factor, so any mismatch in the scaling factors directly affects the resampling loop bounds."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"load_jpeg_image","line":3770,"var":"r->resample","code":"else                               r->resample = stbi__resample_row_generic;","note":"The malformed geometry falls into the generic resampler instead of one of the narrow special-case kernels."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__resample_row_generic","line":3509,"var":"out[i*hs+j]","code":"out[i*hs+j] = in_near[i];","note":"The generic resampler writes expanded output using attacker-influenced bounds; with sufficiently large rows and mismatched geometry, this write can step beyond the intended destination row."}
]
JSON
cat /workspace/candidate_trace.json` executed with exit code 0.
